table:inprior.how: geometric mean over the 4 in-prior configs of the per-config geometric-mean MASE ratio to oracle, context 2048

table:chaos_main.how: per-config geometric mean over seeds of MASE ratio to oracle (and to the best classical model), context 2048, horizon 128

table:lorenz_lyap.how: 209M, context 2048; Lyapunov times = sampling step x horizon x exponent

table:tails_main.how: per-config geometric mean over seeds of MASE ratio to oracle (and to the best classical model), context 2048, horizon 128

table:long_ctx.how: geometric mean over 8 seeds of MASE ratio to oracle at H=128 (oracle rows matched per context length)

table:analog.how: geometric mean over 8 seeds of MASE (context 2048, horizon 128) for the oracle, the method of analogues, the seasonal template, and Timestral

table:chaos_noise.how: geometric mean over 16 seeds of MASE ratio to oracle, context 2048, horizon 128

table:readouts.how: 300 samples per setting; cross-validated R2 of predicting the oracle's expected change (first patch, or step 1) from Timestral's output vs. from the best per-layer linear readout of the first forecast token

table:selfval.how: geometric mean over fresh samples of MASE(fix) / MASE(Timestral); frozen rule K=2, m=0.7

table:regime.how: geometric mean over 8 seeds of MASE ratio to oracle, context 2048, horizon 128

table:cov_past.how: past_cov rows at T=2048, H=16: covariate gain (MASE(uni)/MASE(past_cov)) / oracle gain (MASE(uni)/MASE(matched oracle)), geometric means over samples

table:cov_known_lag.how: LaggedDriver known_cov, T=2048, H=16: covariate gain and matched-oracle gain (geometric means)

table:cov_leaky.how: LeakyKnown noise ratio 0.05, known_cov, T=2048: MASE / matched-oracle MASE = oracle gain / covariate gain (geometric means over the same samples)

table:rd_analogue.how: Timestral MASE / best classical MASE (geometric mean): real analogue windows vs the synthetic family at T=2048, H=128

table:bench_diag_ft.how: Timestral-209M on OffPrior-Diag by failure type

table:search_comparison.how: equal budget per run at 5M; fitness = MASE(Timestral) / MASE(oracle), geometric mean over 3 search seeds; cells = MAP-Elites grid (dominant family x spectral entropy, 40 cells) filled by each method's genomes; floored = only genomes whose oracle sCRPS is at least 0.05 x seasonal naive's

table:search_oracle.how: the best genome of each search run, rebuilt with the search seeds: absolute MASE of Timestral-5M, the oracle and seasonal naive (geometric means over the 3 seeds)

table:search_transfer.how: top elites re-scored with fresh seeds on each size; floored = genomes whose oracle sCRPS is at least 0.05 x seasonal naive's

table:ft_local_lofo.how: 5M, protocol lofo, held-out test sets: geometric-mean MASE ratio to oracle before and after, paired ratio with 95% interval

table:ft_local_knob.how: 5M, protocol knob, held-out test sets: geometric-mean MASE ratio to oracle before and after, paired ratio with 95% interval

table:ft_local_regression.how: regression sets: paired MASE ratio fine-tuned / pretrained

table:ft_colab_heldout.how: held-out test sets, 32 samples each: paired MASE ratio fine-tuned / pretrained over the 24 runs (4 held-out sets x 6 methods) per size and protocol; better/worse = 95% interval entirely below/above 1

table:ft_colab_regression.how: regression sets (in-prior: 500 series with oracle; real: 40 windows, no oracle): paired MASE ratio fine-tuned / pretrained over the 32 runs per method (4 sizes x 2 protocols x 4 held-out sets); worse = 95% interval above 1

table:nn_one_job.how: share of live poles per class at theta 0.7, floor 0.1 (main corpus, all layers, both poles); interval: bootstrap over poles

table:nn_context.how: the same scoring on corpora of different context length (theta 0.7, floor 0.1); E = best of single, pair and additive readout R^2

table:nn_series_control.how: theta 0.7, floor 0.1; main corpus subsampled at random to fewer series (3 seeds at 5M), and each corpus scored with the variable library common to all corpora

table:nn_direction.how: positive control: residual-stream steering along ridge readout directions (mixed test series); gain = effect on the forecast level / move of the readout, both in context standard deviations

table:nn_groups.how: group steering: share of groups (top-k poles of one label, jointly scaled) matching their prediction, against random groups of the same size

table:nn_motif.how: main corpus, all series and random subsamples (mean over seeds): known-variable one-job share and the share of poles whose top exemplars mostly share one of 16 shape clusters

table:nn_steering.how: single-pole steering (scales 0, 0.5, 2, 4) judged against the pre-registered predictions; controls are random poles with a random predicted direction

table:nn_failure_link.how: failing chaos contexts: enrichment of chaos-labeled poles among poles elevated on failing vs reference contexts, and the forecast's MASE ratio to the oracle before and after ablating the elevated periodic-label poles (or as many random poles in the same layers)
